title: How to link your U.S. and Canadian bank accounts in the RBC Mobile App
description: This video shows you how to link and view your RBC U.S. and Canadian accounts within your RBC Mobile App.

asr.full_text: Welcome! In this video we will show you how to link your US and Canadian accounts in the RBC Mobile App. Linking your RBC Bank US accounts lets you transfer money between accounts in seconds. Here's how you link them. Start on the home screen of the RBC Mobile App. Press the Manage menu, three-dot button on the right side of the Account Overview area. Next, select Manage Linked Accounts, then press the Link Accounts button. On the Linked Accounts screen, select RBC Bank US. Next, enter your US online banking username and password, and hit Link. You created these when you opened your US account. Turn on the Primary Account option, and then select which US banking and credit card accounts. You want to view in your app. Once you have made your choices, press Done. Your US accounts are now linked to your Canadian accounts in your RBC mobile app. To double check, go back to the home screen and look for your US accounts. If they're displayed, you're done. If not, hit the Manage Menu three-dot button again to customize which accounts are displayed. Then select Customize Accounts. Choose and arrange which accounts you want displayed in the Accounts Overview. You can move your accounts up and down so that they're displayed in the order you prefer. Hit Done and you're finished!
